title: Security request routing hub for customer contracts and questionnaires
creator: Isha Ramanathan
description: Problem: Fortune 100 and regulated customers submit security questionnaires, SOC2 addenda, DPAs and bespoke contract clauses via multiple channels (sales, support, legal intake forms). Right now these requests are manually triaged by different teams, causing inconsistent SLAs, duplicated effort, and delayed contract signings. We need a single routing hub that classifies inbound security/compliance asks, scores urgency & customer tier, and maps each request to the right queue (Security Ops, Legal, Solutions Engineering, Dedicated Onboarding) with a recommended SLA and next-step template.
goals: Define an unequivocal routing taxonomy for security & compliance requests (questionnaire types, regulatory domains, contractual clauses)
Automate initial classification and routing for >= 70% of incoming requests using rule-based and heuristic scoring
Standardize SLAs and response templates per route (e.g., 3 business days for DPA clarifications, 10 business days for full vendor questionnaire)
Reduce time-to-first-response for enterprise security asks by 40% within the quarter
Provide clear handoff metadata (customer tier, contract reference, required reviewers, required evidence links) to downstream teams
scope: Inbound channels: Support ticket form, sales intake link, legal intake email alias, GitHub issues for integrations
Classifications: SOC2/ISO audit evidence requests, HIPAA onboarding questions, GDPR/DPA clause negotiations, third-party vendor questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ), custom contract clauses
Outputs: route assignment, SLA tag, response template, checklist of standard evidence and owner list
Integrations: Zendesk (support), Salesforce (sales), Confluence (evidence), Slack (alerts), Linear (create downstream tasks)
out_of_scope: Automated completion of questionnaires (we will only route and surface templates/evidence)
Deep legal negotiation work — the hub will hand off to Legal but not perform negotiations
Full AI-based classification in first iteration (will be hybrid rule + manual override)
proposed_solution: Build a lightweight routing service ("Security Routing Hub") that ingests requests from defined sources, applies a deterministic rule-table plus a simple scoring function to classify request type and urgency, then emits a routed artifact into Linear and notifies the target queue in Slack. The rule-table will be editable by PMs and Security leads through a small console UI; routing decisions will include a rationale field for audit. Start with a rule-first approach (keyword mappings, source heuristics, account tier), instrument metrics, then iterate toward ML-assisted classification in Q3. Key outputs: standardized SLA labels, canned response templates per route, evidence checklist templates linked to Confluence, auto-creation of downstream Linear issues with prefilled metadata.
routing_logic_examples: Example 1: Incoming support ticket contains keyword 'SOC2 report' + customer_tier = enterprise -> route=Security Ops Review; SLA=5 biz days; template=send latest SOC2 report link; evidence_required=[control matrix, SOC2 report URL]

Example 2: Sales intake form asks 'require HIPAA' + region=US -> route=Dedicated Onboarding + Legal; SLA=10 biz days; template=HIPAA readiness checklist; evidence_required=[BAA draft, infra controls page]

Example 3: Uploaded vendor questionnaire file type=SIG + size>2MB -> route=Solutions Engineering; SLA=7 biz days; template=request clarification on ambiguous controls; attach parser-transformed CSV summary
acceptance_criteria: Rule table defined and stored in central config; PM and Security lead can edit without engineering deploy
End-to-end flow from intake -> route -> Linear issue creation -> Slack notification works in sandbox with three source types
Metrics dashboard shows routing accuracy (manual overrides / automatic routes) and average time-to-first-response per route
Templates for top 5 request types (SOC2 report, DPA, HIPAA, GDPR data mapping, SIG/CAIQ) are created and approved by Legal and Security
Pilot with Sales + Support for two accounts and observe >=40% reduction in time-to-first-response for the pilot set
dependencies: ENG-2245 (Linear API: bulk issue creation with metadata)
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-rigid rules misroute ambiguous asks -> Mitigation: include mandatory 'human-review' flag if confidence < threshold; track overrides
Risk: Legal ownership disputes on SLA -> Mitigation: run alignment workshop and bake SLA into routing config that requires Legal's sign-off
Risk: Data leakage of sensitive evidence links -> Mitigation: enforce Confluence link permission checks and only surface pointers, not raw documents
